name: toeic-vocab-master
description: Ứng dụng học từ vựng TOEIC kèm trợ lý tiếng Anh trên desktop
author: Lexforge

scripts.build:selection-monitor:dev: cross-env APPDATA=$INIT_CWD/.nuget-home dotnet restore electron/selection-monitor/Lexforge.SelectionMonitor.csproj --configfile electron/selection-monitor/NuGet.Config && cross-env APPDATA=$INIT_CWD/.nuget-home dotnet build electron/selection-monitor/Lexforge.SelectionMonitor.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore
scripts.build:selection-monitor: cross-env APPDATA=$INIT_CWD/.nuget-home NUGET_PACKAGES=$INIT_CWD/.nuget-home/packages dotnet restore electron/selection-monitor/Lexforge.SelectionMonitor.csproj --runtime win-x64 --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --configfile electron/selection-monitor/NuGet.Config -p:RuntimeFrameworkVersion=10.0.10 && cross-env APPDATA=$INIT_CWD/.nuget-home NUGET_PACKAGES=$INIT_CWD/.nuget-home/packages dotnet publish electron/selection-monitor/Lexforge.SelectionMonitor.csproj --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 --self-contained true -p:RuntimeFrameworkVersion=10.0.10 -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=None --no-restore --output electron/selection-monitor/publish
scripts.electron-dev: npm run build:selection-monitor:dev && concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none npm start" "wait-on --timeout 300000 --interval 1000 http://localhost:3000 && electron ."
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:selection-monitor && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:selection-monitor && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:selection-monitor && electron-builder --win
